chunks: And whatever is in it from Aḥmad ibn ʿĀʾidh, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ʿĪsā, from Al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-Washshāʾ, from Aḥmad ibn ʿĀʾidh.

key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him.'
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author's act of narration.
key_terms.عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ: From Aḥmad ibn ʿĀʾidh; identifies the endpoint of this transmission route.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Aḥmad ibn ʿĀʾidh in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Aḥmad ibn ʿĀʾidh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith literature and preserving the route of narration in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
